candidates.change_summary: Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transferFrom no longer changes ownership of the token.
Write the new owner into the wrong key, `_ownerOf[from] = to;`, instead of `_ownerOf[id] = to;`, leaving the token's ownership entry unchanged.
Remove the assignment `_ownerOf[id] = to;` in _mint so minted positions are never registered as owned.
Mint sets `_ownerOf[id] = address(0);` instead of `_ownerOf[id] = to;`, so newly minted positions appear unowned.
Remove the decrement of _balanceOf[from] so the sender's balance is not reduced.
Remove the increment of _balanceOf[to] so the recipient's balance is not increased.
Decrement the recipient's balance instead of the sender's, so balances move the wrong way.
Decrement instead of increment the recipient's balance on mint.
Remove the balance increment so minting does not increase the recipient's balance.
Remove the balance decrement so burning does not decrease the owner's balance.
Increment instead of decrement the owner's balance on burn.
